inputs.script: Practice makes skills. Each project follows the same steps: write a brief, set specifications, build, then check quality. Here is a bakery post, built in one minute of fast-forward. Notice the single headline, the one photo, and the clear call to action. Next, the same design in three sizes: square, portrait and story. Keep key text away from the top and bottom of a story. Save every finished file in a Practice folder. Your portfolio will come from these files.
